content.title: What stores are open on Easter Sunday 2026? Walmart, Dunkin’ and more
content.text: BusinessSeveral stores will be open on Easter 2026. However, a few may be closed on the holiday which is celebrated on Sunday, April 5.Canva/ShopRite/7-Eleven/Walgreens/Dunkin'/Walmart/Katherine RodriguezBy Katherine Rodriguez | NJ.comEaster is celebrated on Sunday, April 5, this year.Some stores will be open and operating at their usual hours to accommodate people who are shopping for last-minute purchases.Most restaurants will be open for people who are dining out to celebrate the holiday.Others, however, will operate at modified hours or remain closed to give employees time off to spend with their loved ones for the Easter holiday.Here is your complete guide to store hours for Easter 2026.Which grocery stores are open on Easter Sunday?The following major supermarket chains in New Jersey are expected to be open on Easter:ACME (6 a.m. - 10 p.m.; varies by store) BJ’s Wholesale Club (8 a.m. - 7 p.m.; varies by store)Foodtown (varies by store)Lidl (8 a.m. - 9 p.m.)ShopRite (varies by store)Stop & Shop (7 a.m. - 5 p.m.)Trader Joe’s (8 a.m. - 9 p.m.)Walmart (6 a.m. - 11 p.m.; varies by store)Wegmans (6 a.m. - 12 a.m.)Whole Foods (7:30 a.m. - 6 p.m.; varies by store)Which four grocery stores are closed on Easter Sunday?The following four major supermarket chains in New Jersey are scheduled to be closed on Easter Sunday:What stores are open on Easter Sunday?
